name: Radios and RF modules
summary: Radios and RF modules: receivers, two-way radios, scanners and small data links.
uses: Talking with other groups (handhelds, CB, ham)
Remote alarms and sensors (433 MHz modules)
identify: Handheld two-way radios at shops, security desks and schools; CB rigs in trucks; ham gear in hobbyists’ homes; scanners and shortwave receivers; small 433 MHz modules in gate remotes, doorbells and weather stations.
test: Power it and listen on a busy channel or the FM band. With two radios, check they hear each other at range.
